title: Bounded relation recovery for published engineering relations: reproducibility package and reference evaluator
description: Reproducibility package for a bounded relation recovery (BRR) protocol. The protocol binds a candidate engineering relation to typed predicates, finite-precision interval evidence and provenance, and returns exactly one auditable action: reject the route, retain a bounded claim, or allow a bounded query. Contents: the action schema and reference evaluator (src/brr, run `python -m brr.evaluate --self-test`), the typed knowledge graph with one run record per relation, the action trace, query examples for both relations, the transcribed public-table inputs, and the derived tables behind every figure. Cold-formed steel supplies the two evidence programmes; the contract itself is domain-independent. The package does not contain the manuscript, third-party model files, or the AISI report.
